text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we work. Many companies now use automation to handle repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI help workers organise their schedules, write emails, and analyse data more quickly. Instead of replacing people completely, AI often works alongside humans. For example, doctors use AI to help diagnose illnesses, while teachers use it to create lessons. Of course, these changes mean some jobs may disappear, but new roles are also appearing. Workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive. Overall, AI can make our work easier if we learn to use it wisely.
